reading.body:
RIC2 DC2 is one building in a planned five-building campus that QTS Realty Trust (formerly Quality Technology Services) is developing on 85 acres in Sandston, Virginia. The operator has published a target of 180 MW total for the complete Richmond 2 campus upon completion, but this campus is not yet fully operating and contributes no capacity to current Virginia totals. The published specifications do not state how much of the 180 MW target applies to this specific building or when completion is expected.

If the 180 MW planned capacity were evenly distributed across five buildings, DC2 would represent roughly 36 MW of IT load. At a typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, this would correspond to approximately 900 racks; at 8 accelerators per rack, this would be roughly 7,200 accelerators. The actual density and current status of this specific building are not published.

Virginia has 23 facilities with published power figures totaling 1,375 MW; when the Richmond 2 campus reaches full operation, it would add 180 MW to that sum and would rank around 24th statewide by published capacity. The state has 326 mapped facilities overall, most of which publish no specifications. This campus's contribution to Virginia's AI infrastructure depends entirely on the timing and allocation of its completion across the five planned buildings.
